contract.current_delivery_continuity: Callback registry mutation does not interrupt the active delivery chain
contract.current_delivery_snapshot: Callbacks added during delivery do not receive the already-active event
contract.removed_callback_current_delivery: Callbacks removed during delivery continue receiving the already-active event
contract.future_delivery_activation: Newly registered callbacks become active on subsequent emits
contract.future_delivery_removal: Unregistered callbacks are absent from subsequent emits
contract.delivery_order_preservation: Existing callbacks preserve their active delivery order
contract.registry_stability: Callback mutation does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful across delivery-time callback mutations
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus callback mutation operations require the events permission
